title: Deepfake: The Digital Doppelganger
tagline: Detect the fake. Defend the real.
shortDescription: Deepfake: The Digital Doppelganger is a workshop conducted by ACM-VIT in 2025 on deepfake detection and the basics of machine learning, attended by more than 100 participants.
longDescription: Deepfake: The Digital Doppelganger was a hands-on workshop conducted by ACM-VIT in 2025, focused on deepfake detection and the fundamentals of machine learning. With over 100 participants, it introduced students to the growing challenge of AI-generated synthetic media and equipped them with practical skills to identify and combat it.

The session taught participants about the mechanics of deepfake generation, the basics of machine learning that power it, and practical deepfake detection techniques. Participants got hands-on experience running detection models on their own devices, making it an accessible introduction to applied AI security.
perks: Hands-on deepfake detection on personal devices
